# /boot/config.txt for ClockworkPi uConsole CM4
# Generated by Voiduconsole. Mirrors clockworkpi's pi-gen settings.

[pi4]
dtoverlay=clockworkpi-uconsole
dtoverlay=vc4-kms-v3d-pi4,cma-384
enable_uart=1
max_framebuffers=2

[all]
ignore_lcd=1
disable_overscan=1
dtparam=audio=on
dtoverlay=audremap,pins_12_13
dtoverlay=dwc2,dr_mode=host
dtparam=ant2
dtparam=spi=on

# GPIOs that hold the panel reset / backlight enable on at boot
gpio=10=ip,np
gpio=9=op,dh

# Required for ClockworkPi shipped overlays
dtoverlay=devterm-pmu
dtoverlay=devterm-panel-uc
dtoverlay=devterm-misc

# Use the 64-bit kernel
arm_64bit=1
kernel=kernel8.img

# A bit of headroom for the modem + USB host on the back board
over_voltage=2
arm_boost=1
